field.label: Enable quick product update
field.comment: Experimental, please note: This uses the action updateAttributes and the StockRegistry instead of the product repository to update products faster but might give issues when using MSI and won't work with certain changes like media_gallery or linked_products.

field.label: Disable Stock Registry
field.comment:
Please note: The stock registry feature should only be disabled when problems with updating inventory items via bulk REST API occur.
By default, when updating inventory stock items in bulk via the REST API, the queue consumer uses a registry to cache stock item data. So when an API update comes along that has the same quantity to a previously applied update, the quantity update is ignored.
When disabling this, all stock item updates will be processed.
This may resolve issues when excessive (identical) API updates are triggered by an external system, and changes made in Magento (by sales or manually via admin) are not overwritten by these updates.
